about.bio1: Hanon is a singer and VTuber. She's one half of the vocal duo HaKoniwalily together with Kotoha, the vocalist of the music trio StellaPhizz, and a guest vocalist for HoneyWorks.
about.bio2: She started posting covers in 2018 and made her VTuber debut with AiceClass in July 2023 (first stream: July 9). Every Monday and Thursday from 21:00 JST she hosts #はのらじ — singing, games and chats. Her fans are called Hanomen (はのメン), and her fan mark is 🐧.

about.heading: ABOUT
facts: Hanon and Kotoha are both 152 cm tall.
Besides HaKoniwalily, Hanon is the vocalist of the music trio StellaPhizz.
She sang the opening theme of 『29歳独身中堅冒険者の日常』 solo, as "HoneyWorks feat.Hanon".
Fan art tagged #はのぴく may be used for her thumbnails.
Her hobbies: singing, watching movies, eating delicious food and sleeping.
Her most-viewed cover is 金曜日のおはよう -another story-.
Hanon and Kotoha's voices are also a CeVIO AI voice library: 箱庭ハノ・コト.
